summary: This report reviews and recommends approval of the application to amend the Zoning By-law to permit a 12-storey (47.5 metres including mechanical penthouse) mixed-use building containing 180 dwelling units. The proposal results in an appropriate built form that fits with the existing and planned context of the surrounding area. Staff recommend that Council support approval of the application.
